observations.before_signature: The seasonal page had the shared hero but no source-backed case cards, format comparison, FAQ or video explanations.
observations.after_signature: Direct H1, natural subtitle, six trust chips and a full-width date CTA remain readable; formats, proof cases, FAQ and form stack to one column; scrollWidth equals 390.
observations.observed_visible_result: Mobile keeps the approved visual language while adding the planned decision-support content without horizontal overflow.

observations.before_signature: The tablet route reused the main design but lacked structured service formats and verified-case narratives.
observations.after_signature: All new sections render in the mobile/tablet composition, primary CTA stays on one line and document scrollWidth equals 768.
observations.observed_visible_result: The 768 boundary preserves usable controls and complete content with no clipped cards or page overflow.

observations.before_signature: After the content update, the intrinsic 1200px workflow SVG created a 19px document overflow immediately above the tablet breakpoint.
observations.after_signature: The workflow connector is constrained to 100% of its container; document scrollWidth equals 1181 and the hero CTA remains one line.
observations.observed_visible_result: The exact B+1 boundary now transitions cleanly from tablet to desktop without a horizontal scrollbar.

observations.before_signature: The live baseline used the old subtitle and had no proof-case cards, FAQ or explanatory video copy.
observations.after_signature: The shared hero geometry is preserved with the revised Russian subtitle; three formats, three letter-backed cases, six FAQ items and four video captions are present.
observations.observed_visible_result: Desktop remains recognizably the existing corporate design while the content now answers composition, proof and preparation questions.

observations.before_signature: Wide layout contained the earlier shared blocks only and did not provide the planned formats, cases or FAQ.
observations.after_signature: New sections stay bounded by the wide-screen container, proof previews remain legible and document scrollWidth equals 1984.
observations.observed_visible_result: The additional conversion content scales without stretched controls, clipped text or layout drift on a wide viewport.

responsive_matrix.boundary_policy: B-1, B and B+1 plus representative mobile, tablet, desktop and wide anchors
